messages:
maya: Heads-up — nightly eval flagged a regression on tool-calling. Multiple prompts that expect an array of suggestion objects now return a string like \"[\\\"a\\\",\\\"b\\\"]\" instead of an array. Failing ~23/200 cases.

kevin: Ugh. repro log? sample output?

maya: Pasted one of the failing outputs below (from nightly run):
```json
{"tool_call": {"name": "suggestions", "args": "[\"fast-mode\", \"low-latency\"]"}}
```

maya: Schema validator error: `expected array, found string` at `tool_call.args`.

eval-bot: nightly-eval v2.3 report: model rdm-2.1-q4 promoted yesterday. Regression introduced vs baseline rdm-2.0-fp16. Failure rate increased from 1.2% -> 11.5% for JSON-list prompts.

tia: That smells like serialization change in the function-calling logic or the generation sampling producing quotes around brackets. Could be q4 tokenization boundary.

kevin: Quick triage plan: 1) run the failing prompt set against rdm-2.1-fp16 (non-quant) and rdm-2.1-q4 to see if quantization matters, 2) run model with deterministic sampling (temp=0) to see if stochastic quoting is causing it, 3) check serving runtime postprocess for accidental string coercion.

anton: I pulled the raw model outputs from the replay store for a couple of samples:
```
...
prefix: \"call suggestions\"
model_gen: \"\\\"[\\\\\\\"fast-mode\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"low-latency\\\\\\\"]\\\"\"
...
```

anton: Looks like model literally generated the quotes around the list. Not postprocess.

kevin: If the model generated the quotes, we need to see whether the tokenizer change or recent training/finetune prompt framing caused it. Any prompt framing differences in the new variant?

maya: rdm-2.1 includes an augmented instruction template that emphasizes explicit JSON blobs. Could be over-escaping. I will diff the prompt templates.

deploy-bot: model rdm-2.1-q4 deployed to prod-dedicated at 2026-11-02T03:14:22Z (rollout: 100%).

tia: Could also be temperature / sampling topk leading to bracket tokenization split, causing the model to add extra quotes. Let's run a small sample locally with `--no-sampling`.

kevin: I started local runs: rdm-2.1-fp16 reproduces correct array outputs, rdm-2.1-q4 reproduces the quoted-list ~8/20. So likely quantization affects generation pattern.

anton: Filed an internal issue: https://issues.redwood.ai/INF-2143 — assigned to @kevin. Add the failing prompt IDs and raw generations.

maya: Work items: (a) add a post-filter in eval harness to attempt JSON parsing and coerce stringified arrays where safe, so nightly alerts are less noisy while we root-cause; (b) add unit test comparing fp16 vs q4 outputs for the core prompt set; (c) investigate quant kernel differences that shift tokenization boundaries.

kevin: I'll own the q4 kernel repros and bisect the quant codepath. Will try the quantized model with forced detokenization tweaks (disable merging of `[` token with quotes).

tia: For short-term mitigations we can: - update evaluator to run schema validator that attempts `json.loads` if arg is string and startswith `[` or `{` and logs a coercion, - surface these as WARN not ERROR for one nightly run until a patch. Thoughts? :eyes:

maya: Good plan. Please add the coercion attempt behind a flag so we don't hide real schema mismatches.

anton: Putting repro artifacts and a small harness in the INF-2143 ticket. Also attaching token-level deltas for one example.

kevin: ETA on first bisect pass ~ 24h. Will post logs and a short proof-of-concept patch to the ticket. :hammer:

maya: Thanks team. Let's sync in tomorrow standup if there are blocking findings. If someone sees this as high priority for a customer, ping me.

eval-bot: nightly-eval action: test-suite flagged 23 failing samples. Coercion mitigation enabled for next run: false.

maya: I'll follow up after bisect.
